checking_content:
Initial Load and Scene Readiness Verification
Preconditions: Open index.html in a browser and wait for loading to complete.
Steps:
  1. Observe the screen after the loading animation (#loading) disappears. -> expected: Loading prompt disappears, 3D scene renders normally, including water, mangrove roots, sky, and base UI (#hud-top, #hud-bottom, #hints).
Pass: Loading animation completely disappears, scene and UI are simultaneously visible without blocking errors.
expected_result: Loading animation completely disappears, scene and UI are simultaneously visible without blocking errors.

checking_content:
Root Navigation and Proximity Sway Feedback
Preconditions: Scene has loaded completely.
Steps:
  1. Use left mouse drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, right drag to pan. Move camera close to any mangrove root. -> expected: Camera can freely orbit and pass through roots. Root material displays bark texture.
  2. Keep camera close to roots, slightly move mouse to observe root morphology. -> expected: Roots exhibit visible subtle sway animation.
Pass: Camera can pass through roots without collision, and root sway animation triggers when close.
expected_result: Camera can pass through roots without collision, and root sway animation triggers when close.

checking_content:
Water Ripple Generation and Click Interaction
Preconditions: Scene loaded, camera positioned above water.
Steps:
  1. Slowly move mouse pointer across the water surface area. -> expected: Diffusing ripple waves generate in real-time along the mouse trajectory.
  2. Left-click anywhere on the water surface. -> expected: Distinct impact ripple generates at click point, accompanied by splash diffusion effect.
Pass: Both mouse movement and clicks trigger corresponding water ripple animations, with waves decaying over time.
expected_result: Both mouse movement and clicks trigger corresponding water ripple animations, with waves decaying over time.

checking_content:
Fish School Multi-layer Depth and Interaction Scatter
Preconditions: Scene loaded.
Steps:
  1. Rotate view to top-down over water, observe underwater area. -> expected: Multiple fish schools visible at different depth layers, moving with natural trajectories.
  2. Left-click on the water surface above a fish school area. -> expected: Fish school at corresponding depth immediately changes direction, exhibiting scatter/flee behavior.
Pass: Fish schools show multi-layer distribution, move organically, and trigger clear scatter response after water click.
expected_result: Fish schools show multi-layer distribution, move organically, and trigger clear scatter response after water click.

checking_content:
Time Slider Controls Lighting and Sky Changes
Preconditions: Scene loaded.
Steps:
  1. Drag bottom #time-slider from 0 to 24. -> expected: Sky color gradients, light shaft intensity and direction change, #time-readout value updates synchronously.
Pass: Sky and lighting respond smoothly throughout slider drag, readout value accurately matches slider position.
expected_result: Sky and lighting respond smoothly throughout slider drag, readout value accurately matches slider position.

checking_content:
Wind Slider Controls Wave Amplitude
Preconditions: Scene loaded.
Steps:
  1. Drag #wind-slider from 0 to 1. -> expected: Water wave amplitude visibly increases, ripple propagation speed accelerates, #wind-readout percentage updates synchronously.
Pass: Wave amplitude and propagation speed change linearly/smoothly with slider value, readout accurate.
expected_result: Wave amplitude and propagation speed change linearly/smoothly with slider value, readout accurate.

checking_content:
Ambient Audio Toggle Control
Preconditions: Scene loaded, initial #audio-nudge prompt visible.
Steps:
  1. Click #sound-btn button. -> expected: #audio-nudge prompt disappears, ambient audio (water/bird/insect) starts playing, button shows active style.
  2. Click #sound-btn button again. -> expected: Ambient audio stops/mutes, button reverts to inactive style.
Pass: Clicking button successfully toggles audio state, UI feedback and prompt dismissal logic correct.
expected_result: Clicking button successfully toggles audio state, UI feedback and prompt dismissal logic correct.

checking_content:
Auto Tour Mode Toggle
Preconditions: Scene loaded, camera defaults to auto-rotation state.
Steps:
  1. Click #tour-btn button. -> expected: Camera auto-rotation stops, button shows inactive style.
  2. Click #tour-btn button again. -> expected: Camera resumes auto-rotation, button shows active style.
Pass: Button correctly toggles camera auto-rotation state, UI style updates synchronously.
expected_result: Button correctly toggles camera auto-rotation state, UI style updates synchronously.

checking_content:
Underwater Mode Transition and Overlay
Preconditions: Scene loaded, camera positioned above water.
Steps:
  1. Use mouse drag to lower camera position below water surface (y < 0). -> expected: Top-right #mode-label text changes to UNDERWATER, screen overlays blue-green radial gradient (#underwater-overlay).
  2. Drag camera back above water surface. -> expected: #mode-label reverts to SURFACE, blue-green overlay fades out.
Pass: Mode label and overlay state switch accurately when camera crosses water surface, transition smooth.
expected_result: Mode label and overlay state switch accurately when camera crosses water surface, transition smooth.

checking_content:
FPS and Mode Status HUD Display
Preconditions: Scene loaded.
Steps:
  1. Observe top-right #stats area, perform drag/zoom operations. -> expected: #fps value updates in real-time, #mode-label accurately reflects current camera position (SURFACE/UNDERWATER).
Pass: FPS counter updates continuously, mode label matches actual camera state.
expected_result: FPS counter updates continuously, mode label matches actual camera state.
